BiblicalUsage: Helah is one of the two wives of Ashur the father of Tekoa, and her sons are Zereth, Jezoar, and Ethnan. She is named only in the genealogy of Judah, as the mother of three sons.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God names the mothers in the genealogy as well as the fathers. Helah's sons are counted, and her name stands at the head of them.
